theorems.name: Submission.adr_rescaled_translate_tendstoUniformly
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (y : Euclid P) (mus : ℕ → ℝ), Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → Tendsto mus atTop (𝓝 1) → ∃ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K ∧ (∀ w ∉ K, f (w - y) = 0) ∧ (∀ᶠ k in atTop, ∀ w ∉ K, f ((mus k)⁻¹ • (w - y)) = 0) ∧ TendstoUniformly (fun k w => f ((mus k)⁻¹ • (w - y))) (fun w => f (w - y)) atTop
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
